# SEO and Content
- Initialize Caveman first.
- Prioritize useful, original product discovery content over thin affiliate pages.
- Use descriptive titles, meta descriptions, readable slugs, canonical URLs, sitemap, robots.txt, social metadata, and internal links.
- Add structured data only when eligible and accurate; never fabricate ratings, reviews, prices, availability, or product attributes.
- Clearly disclose affiliate relationships near recommendations where appropriate.
- Use appropriate sponsored/external link attributes.
- Do not scrape merchants or reuse assets/copy/reviews without permission or a valid license.
- Date or qualify price/availability unless reliably refreshed.
- Avoid doorway pages, keyword stuffing, duplicate pages, and misleading claims.
- Verify generated routes and metadata in build output where possible.
- No paid SEO/analytics services without approval.
